counterfactual_missing_items: no history of myopia, ocular trauma, or surgery
MRI of the brain and orbits showed mild posterior scleral enhancement but no intraocular mass
decisive_items: presumed serous retinal detachment secondary to posterior scleritis
mild posterior scleral enhancement but no intraocular mass
response.rationale: R3 is the unifying causal diagnosis: posterior scleral enhancement and the explicit attribution of the serous retinal detachment to posterior scleritis are decisive. R1 is the downstream complication, not the underlying diagnosis, and R2 captures only nonspecific intraocular inflammation without explaining the scleral or imaging findings.

rejected.why: Anterior chamber and vitreous cells are nonspecific inflammatory findings and do not account for posterior scleral enhancement, choroidal detachments, or the serous retinal detachment.
